EN_PROFILE.meta_description: Selects the Enshrouded profile template on first bootstrap (fresh volume).

MANAGER_PROFILE.meta_description: Selects the Server Manager profile template on first bootstrap (fresh volume).

BACKUP_CRON.meta_description: Cron schedule for scheduled backup job (writes to BACKUP_DIR/scheduled).

BACKUP_MAX_COUNT.meta_description: Number of savegame zip backups to keep (0 = unlimited).

RESTART_CHECK_PLAYERS.meta_description: Only restart when 0 players are connected.

RESTART_DOWNTIME_SECONDS.meta_description: Seconds to wait between stop and start during restart.

UPDATE_CHECK_PLAYERS.meta_description: Only update when 0 players are connected.

SERVER_PRE_HOOK.meta_description: Hook executed before server start job.

SERVER_POST_HOOK.meta_description: Hook executed after server stop job.

SERVER_COMMAND_PRE_HOOK.meta_description: Hook executed before server command dispatch.

SERVER_COMMAND_POST_HOOK.meta_description: Hook executed after server command dispatch.

MENU_PRE_HOOK.meta_description: Hook executed before interactive menu job.

MENU_POST_HOOK.meta_description: Hook executed after interactive menu job.

ENSHROUDED_LOG_DIR.meta_description: Log directory (relative to /home/enshrouded/server or absolute path).

ENSHROUDED_NAME.meta_description: Server name shown in the server browser.

ENSHROUDED_SAVE_DIR.meta_description: Savegame directory (relative to /home/enshrouded/server or absolute path).

ENSHROUDED_TAGS.meta_description: Comma-separated server tags written to enshrouded_server.json .tags array.
ENSHROUDED_TAGS.meta_allowed: Comma-separated; each tag: A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ - (empty clears all tags)

ENSHROUDED_GS_FISHING_DIFFICULTY.meta_allowed: Allowed: VeryEasy | Easy | Normal | Hard | VeryHard

ENSHROUDED_GS_PRESET.meta_allowed: Allowed: Default | Relaxed | Hard | Survival | Custom

CAN_ACCESS_INVENTORIES.meta_description: Allow access to other players' inventories.

PASSWORD.meta_description: User group password (empty = auto-generated if missing in config).

RESERVED_SLOTS.meta_description: Reserved slots for this user group.
